notes: The saying is not written here («نحو هذا الحديث بمعناه»): the chain ends at the father, with no Companion named in this report
«وهذا أصح من حديث يعلى بن شبيب» is Tirmidhi's remark on another narration: a variant group, not a route
«ولم يذكر فيه عن عائشة» is a remark on the wording of the earlier version and is left out
